left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  No systemic disease,
  -  the presence of high labial frenulum attachment diagnosed according to Mirko et al

, -periodontally healthy  [OR] or a requirement for periodontal treatment that would only require removing of dental plaque,
  -  full mouth plaque score <15%,probing pocket depth <3mm in all teeth
  -  no history of periodontal surgery

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  not meet the optimal level of oral hygiene,
  -  had any condition that could affect wound healing,
  -  were pregnant  [OR] or lactating,
  -  were cigarette smokers  [OR] or were takiing any medication that might affect the outcome of the study,
